entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2642766361608754432: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.1451 +/- 0.0169 mas (same row, RUWE 0.97): 162.73 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 16.123, -44.070 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.65 +/- 0.06 solar radii from Frensch et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-5300 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...700A.118F/abstract). Mass 0.67 +/- 0.02 solar masses from Frensch et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-5300 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...700A.118F/abstract). Temperature 4610 +/- 207 K from Frensch et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5300 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 4,610 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffe0c0. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,610 K and log g 4.64 (u1 0.753, u2 0.038): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
